task.title: Update the CLI help to include the eval command
task.acceptance: The USAGE string in apps/cli/src/cli.ts must contain the word 'eval' and describe the three metrics (tokens_before_edit, turns, pass/fail).

sections.title: Conventions
sections.body: Follow the surrounding package. Do not invent a new app or package.

sections.title: Commands
sections.body: Workspace: pnpm install, pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, pnpm test, pnpm build, pnpm dev. Scope with pnpm --filter @beacon/<pkg>.

sections.title: Tests
sections.body: If the behavior can be covered by a unit test, add or update one. Put tests next to the code in the same package (*.test.ts), using that package's Vitest setup.
